reply_text:
I replied to Dana in your DM to confirm that their Tamsin Cold Chain pickups now use Dock 15, and that I'll keep it between the two of you.

I searched GBrain first and found nothing about this dock. I didn't save the note to GBrain or to my own memory. Other members can search GBrain, so storing it there could expose something Dana asked to keep private. That means the note lives only in your DM, and I won't recall it in a later session unless the DM history is read again.

The first attempt to send the reply failed because the direct-message tool doesn't accept a DM channel id. I resent it by posting to the DM channel itself, and that went through.
